title: Worst-case query cost
statement: Let a randomized decision tree have a finite, nonempty seed space, and suppose its alphabet is finite and nonempty. Its worst-case cost is the supremum, over all seeds, of the input cost of the deterministic tree selected by that seed.
hypotheses_covered: The randomized tree has a finite, nonempty seed space.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of input cost, so its precise cost convention cannot be specified.
